clues: This big city in south central Turkey sits on a small river. It lies a short drive north of Aleppo, a famed town in Syria.
Summers here scorch and stay dry for months at a time. Winters turn cool and wet, and snow often lies on the ground for days.
This town fell to the Ottoman Empire in the year 1516. The shift came just days before a great battle of that age.
After a huge quake shook this land in 2023, this town stood mostly whole. It then served as the hub where aid teams based their work.
A grand old castle stands as a proud mark of this town. A strong quake in recent years left it scarred and in need of care.
